test_title: PYST 19: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - GA (Held On: 13 Jun, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Uninterrupted and seamless chain of Input Tax Credit (ITC) is a mechanism to avoid cascading of taxes in which of the following taxes?
solution:
The correct answer is __**GST**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Goods and Services Tax (GST)** is a unified indirect tax system implemented in India to **eliminate cascading effects of taxation**.
 
• The concept of **Input Tax Credit (ITC)** under GST allows businesses to claim credit for the tax paid on purchases and use it to offset the tax liability on sales.
 
• GST ensures an **uninterrupted and seamless chain of Input Tax Credit**, reducing the tax burden at each stage of value addition.
 
• ITC under GST is applicable to **both goods and services**, aligning with the “One Nation, One Tax” principle.
 
• This mechanism improves compliance, ensures transparency, and helps in making products and services more competitive in the market.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Cascading Tax Effect:**

 
 
• Occurs when tax is levied on a product at every stage of production without credit for the taxes paid in the earlier stages.
 
• GST eliminates this issue by enabling ITC throughout the supply chain.
 
 
 
• **Input Tax Credit (ITC):**
 
 
• ITC allows taxpayers to deduct the tax paid on inputs from the tax payable on final output.
 
• Conditions for availing ITC include possession of tax invoice, receipt of goods/services, and payment of tax to the government.
 
 
 
• **GST Structure:**
 
 
• GST comprises Central GST (CGST), State GST (SGST), and Integrated GST (IGST).
 
• ITC is transferable between CGST and SGST/IGST under specific rules.
 
 
 
• **Benefits of GST:**
 
 
• Creates a unified tax structure across India, boosting ease of doing business.
 
• Reduces tax evasion by integrating tax systems digitally.
 
• Promotes transparency and reduces litigation in tax administration.
